source.badge_text_exact: UPGRADEUpgrade required: This feature requires upgrading your plan to access.
source.description_exact: Run a giveaway to grow Instagram followers. Want your IG comment section to look like a Black Friday line? Run a giveaway. People love free stuff, and they’ll happily engage with your content to get it
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Run a giveaway
Business value
You’re farming engagement, reach, and new followers who’ve now had a taste of your brand. It's cheap, viral, and builds momentum fast.
How does it work?

Post a Reel with your giveaway item and ask people to comment to enter. Manychat captures entries without you lifting a finger. Use our Randomizer to pick a winner without spreadsheets or existential dread.
